slides.texte_overlay:
1. test yourself instead of rereading

close the book and write what you remember.
the struggle is what makes it stick.

2. space it out

ten minutes today, ten tomorrow, ten next week
beat two hours the night before.

3. make it weird

link a date to a silly picture in your head.
the stranger the image, the longer it stays.

4. walk around a room you know

put each idea in a different spot of your bedroom.
then walk through it in your mind.

5. connect new things to what you already know

before, facts went in one ear and out the other.
now i learn one small thing every morning. and each one hooks onto the last.
